system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 36. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (23 seconds, code score 0.92) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (wailing): "They arrested her!"
[b01] ALEXANDER (stunned): "Arrested?"
[b02] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (despairing): "Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!"
[b03] ALEXANDER (shouting, incredulous): "But she saved you!"
[b04] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (weeping): "I told them!"
[b05] ALEXANDER (furious): "You told them the truth!"
[b06] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (agonized): "They called her a witch!"

--- WINDOW 1 (28 seconds, code score 0.92) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (grim): "Rupert... and Catherine's."
[b01] SFX: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
[b02] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (deadly serious): "Two days from now."
[b03] ALEXANDER (simmering with fury): "They are marrying in two days..."
[b04] ALEXANDER (deadly, throaty): "...and killing my wife afterward."
[b05] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (pleading, terrified): "Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!"
[b06] ALEXANDER (grave, seething): "They already took my name."
[b07] ALEXANDER (roaring with conviction): "They stole my home!"
[b08] ALEXANDER (venomous): "And now they have taken Juliana!"

--- WINDOW 2 (51 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (darkly): "While the world mourned a dead heir."
[b01] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (choked with tears): "And I mourned you."
[b02] ALEXANDER (softly): "I know."
[b03] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (sobbing): "I trusted them."
[b04] ALEXANDER (gentle yet firm): "You trusted family."
[b05] ALEXANDER (resentful): "They used that trust against you."
[b06] ALEXANDER (urgent, anxious): "Mother... Juliana..."
[b07] ALEXANDER (intense): "She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back."
[b08] ALEXANDER (tremulous): "I thought perhaps she stayed with you."
[b09] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (hesitant, trembling): "Alexander..."
[b10] ALEXANDER (alarmed): "What?"
[b11] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (choked): "She did come to me."
[b12] ALEXANDER (demanding): "Is she still at Ashbourne?"
[b13] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (sobbing): "No..."
[b14] ALEXANDER (desperate): "Then where is she?"
[b15] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (wailing): "They arrested her!"

--- WINDOW 3 (25 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (roaring with conviction): "They stole my home!"
[b01] ALEXANDER (venomous): "And now they have taken Juliana!"
[b02] ACTION: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
[b03] SFX: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
[b04] ACTION: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.
[b05] ALEXANDER (calm, chilling): "Two days."
[b06] ALEXANDER (vow of vengeance): "Then they have two days to celebrate."
[b07] ALEXANDER (low, menacing promise): "Because before that wedding begins..."
[b08] ALEXANDER (cold, thunderous finale): "...their dead Duke is coming home."

Pick the single best promo.
